handover_report.title: EverythingAI — Admin Agent Connectors Progress Handover

repository.name: everythingAI
repository.working_branch_policy: All work happens directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

source_of_truth_before_this_work.latest_commit_before_work: 5aaddd2 Add smoke test report for EverythingAI on 2026-06-07
source_of_truth_before_this_work.status: Local MVP hardening smoke-tested and validated.

user_requirement: Client Workspace users should only chat through the AI provider selected by Admin/backend.
Provider and agent configuration should remain Admin Dashboard only.
Proceed in larger implementation steps when safe.

implemented_work.summary: Hardened public /api/chat route by removing request-body provider override. Client chat now follows the admin-selected backend provider only.
Expanded frontend agent integration types and added agent bridge status, detect, detect-all, probe, get, and save API helpers for /api/agent-bridge endpoints.

Added Admin Agent Connectors panel for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and other configured local agent connectors. Includes enable toggles, command/auth/chat settings, bridge status, detect, detect-all, and version probe actions.
Wired AgentConnectorsPanel into Admin Settings below AI provider configuration and above planning policy.
Passed agent bridge status/detection/probe actions through the admin view router.
Added admin runtime state/actions for agent bridge status refresh, individual detection, detect-all, and version probe. Agent connector settings are saved together with AI provider settings.
Extended smoke test to confirm Client Workspace does not expose provider/agent settings and Admin Settings exposes Agent Connectors for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode.

security_and_product_invariants: Client Workspace cannot select provider from UI.
Public /api/chat route no longer accepts request-body provider override.
Client chat uses admin/backend-selected provider through createConfiguredChatAnswer.
Agent connectors are admin-only UI configuration.
Agent bridge execution remains disabled by default unless backend environment flags explicitly enable it.
The browser still cannot submit arbitrary shell commands; only saved connector commands can be detected/probed/chat-enabled through backend rules.
No trust-score or quality-score logic changed.
next_approved_actions: If validation passes, create validation addendum and proceed to controlled connector-specific setup/testing.
